The floor is deliberately NOT justified by bankroll size: 0.37% is 0.37% at any scale and capacity is explicitly not a filter in this project. It is justified by MODEL ERROR — a sub-2pp edge sits inside the uncertainty of my own fee and slippage estimates, and re-running the scan minutes apart moved the same arb from +0.37pp to +0.59pp, so the measurement itself is noisier than the threshold it was firing on. A two-leg structure also converts into an outright directional position the moment one leg fills alone, which is a real cost the raw edge number does not price. Sub-threshold arbs are still LOGGED so nothing is hidden; they just no longer consume a tick dispatch and the 90-minute global cron cooldown that goes with it.
decisions.prediction: No further tick dispatches from sub-2pp monotonicity arbs; the log still records them. Falsified if a genuinely valuable opportunity is ever found sitting in the sub-2pp log band, which would mean the floor is set too high and should be lowered toward the measurement-noise level instead.

Selling above fair beats holding on a position that now carries ZERO edge at 16% of bankroll, and a fill frees the largest single block of capital in the book.
